summary.en: Private messenger; Signal Desktop for Windows is Arm64-optimized, listed as native from 7.34.0.
summary.zh-TW: 注重隱私的即時通訊軟體；Windows 版 Signal Desktop 已針對 Arm64 最佳化，自 7.34.0 起列為原生。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。

caveats.en: Signal.org could not be read from this environment; the news headline says Arm64-optimized and the native result comes from the Linaro catalog.
caveats.zh-TW: 此環境無法讀取 signal.org；新聞標題僅說明已針對 Arm64 最佳化，原生結果來自 Linaro 目錄。
